subject.title: fix(cli): reject unknown models in config set

question: Should `openclaw config set` permanently reject changed text-model references whenever the runtime-compatible prepared catalog cannot resolve them, rather than preserving the prior write-now/fail-on-run behavior?
rationale: The implementation is coherent, but this is an intentional compatibility and operator-experience policy change rather than a remaining mechanical defect.

options.title: Accept write-time rejection
options.body: Merge the PR and make early rejection with the `openclaw models list` recovery hint the supported contract for changed text-model references.

options.title: Preserve deferred validation
options.body: Do not merge the fail-closed behavior and retain the existing ability to persist references that may resolve only at runtime.

recommendation.title: Accept write-time rejection
recommendation.body: Merge the PR and make early rejection with the `openclaw models list` recovery hint the supported contract for changed text-model references.

likelyOwner.reason: The current proposal and its model-resolution refinements are concentrated in this contributor’s focused change history.
